summary: 40-foot L-4 lookout built 1934 near Coolin; removed or destroyed in 1960; 1959 staff Bob Bond; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1960; the register says removed and the other sources say destroyed. No source describes a standing structure.

access.note: On Kaniksu National Forest land. No source says the site is closed. None describes the site today.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in. No source gives a route.

events.note: 40-foot pole L-4 tower built in 1934. All four sources agree.
Mr. Bob Bond listed as known staff in 1959 on Idaho Fire Lookouts. A photo caption dates a Bob Bond photograph of the site to 1959-1960.
Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Weebly page say destroyed in 1960. The register says removed in 1960.
Ruins of the 48-foot patrol tower one mile southwest were still there in the 1980s. Register gives the decade only; 1980 marks the start of the decade, not a dated event.

evidence.quote: Built in 1934, this 40' pole L-4 tower was removed in 1960.
Built in 1934, this 40' pole L-4 tower was removed in 1960.

evidence.supports: patrol tower ruins still there in the 1980s
evidence.quote: The ruins of a Patrol 48' pole L-6 tower located 1 mile southwest were still there in 1980s.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says removed in 1960. Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Weebly page say destroyed in 1960. The record keeps the 1960 date and the majority word, destroyed, and the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Brief had the 1960 fate and the 2013 registration but no 1934 build or 1959 staffing; both added. Height 12.2 m is the 40-foot pole figure (40 ft = 12.19 m). The 48-foot L-6 patrol tower one mile southwest is a separate structure, so it is noted but not treated as the lookout. Its ruins are only described as still there in the 1980s. Elevation 6,361 ft matches the brief's 1938.8 m. Access level 'public' rests on Kaniksu National Forest land and the absence of any closure in the sources; no source describes the site today.
